data.narrative:
SunDrive Solar is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Vince Allen and David Hu. The company has raised A$60M+ to date, including an A$25.3M ARENA grant secured in November 2025. The Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 known private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though no narrow peer set of same-stage or adjacent-stage companies exists with sufficient density for median peer analysis.

Valuation work relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. Using the A$60M+ total raised as a valuation proxy baseline of $4M, this yields an implied value of $10M. A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to the absence of three or more same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables in the Climate & Energy universe; the broader 9-company sector set lacks sufficient homogeneity for reliable median extraction.

The analysis supports a triangulated range of $8M to $12M, with a median point of $10M. This estimate rests on a single methodological pillar, creating material uncertainty. Key risks include the early-stage nature of the valuation, the reliance on raised capital as a proxy for value, and the absence of sector-specific peer benchmarking. The ARENA grant's non-dilutive nature and timing require separate capital structure documentation to refine pricing.
